subject: reasoning
question: Ronny starts from Point A and drives 10.25 km towards the east. He then takes a right turn, drives 12.75 km, turns right and drives 15 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 2.25 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 4.75 km and stops at Point P. How far and towards which direction should he now drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
The direction chart according to the given statement is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dc6e8778b944244380869b916f3cdecfad75c06249a03232e7b674ee646f70a.png] 

Here we can see the distance between points P and A is **12.75 km - 2.25 km = 10.5 km **

Towards the **North** direction should now drive in order to reach Point A again.

Hence,** "Option 2" **is the **correct answer.**
